infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VISHWAS shares your live location with your emergency contacts during an SOS and shows your location status on the dashboard.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VISHWAS records video evidence when you trigger an SOS. Recordings are stored privately on this iPhone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VISHWAS records audio evidence when you trigger an SOS. Recordings are stored privately on this iPhone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VISHWAS lets you choose a photo for an emergency contact.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: VISHWAS lets you pick a trusted person from your contacts. Only the contact you pick is used.
